definition.def: If you attain something, you gain it or achieve it, often after a lot of effort. [formal]
examples: Jim is halfway to attaining his pilot's licence. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If you attain a particular state or condition, you may reach it as a result of natural development or work hard to attain this state.
examples: ...attaining a state of calmness and confidence. [VERB noun]

examples.sentence: Although more and more people attain an advanced age as a result of developments in medical care and better nutrition, the characteristic upper limit for most remains 80 years.
Thus they are not able to 'experience life' and so they attain a high life span in captivity.
Many of these people acquired far more experience of exploration than most Europeans could hope to attain.
